evals.name: Multi-Tier Caching & Bounded Memory Leak Prevention
evals.prompt: Implement an in-memory L1 cache service for frequently accessed user permissions, ensuring process memory is strictly bounded with maximum item count and TTL eviction to prevent OOM leaks.
evals.expected_output: Configures an L1 cache with explicit max items and TTL bounds instead of an unbounded map, preventing Node.js process crashes.
assertions: Defines bounded L1 cache with maximum item capacity constraint
Enforces automatic TTL expiration on all cached entries
Eliminates unbounded Map/object memory leaks in the application process
Provides clear separation between in-process memory and distributed cache storage

evals.name: Hierarchical Cache Key Namespacing & Mandatory TTLs
evals.prompt: Design a caching helper for an e-commerce catalog that formats keys according to standard hierarchical namespacing and guarantees every write includes an explicit TTL.
evals.expected_output: Formats keys using {service}:{entity}:{identifier}:{version} and writes to Redis using EX/PX flags, preventing zombie keys.
assertions: Applies version tag to support instant schema invalidation without global flush
Guarantees all write operations supply explicit TTL duration
Prevents creation of un-expiring zombie keys in Redis

evals.name: Cache Stampede Mitigation & Graceful Database Fallback
evals.prompt: Implement a cache-aside loader that uses distributed mutex locking (SET NX EX) to prevent thundering herds on hot key expiration, and falls back to the database if Redis is unreachable.
evals.expected_output: Uses distributed lock to serialize database queries during cache misses and catches Redis exceptions to fall back to the primary DB.
assertions: Implements distributed mutex locking (NX option) to serialize database reads on cache miss
Prevents concurrent requests from hitting primary database simultaneously during hot key expiration
Catches Redis client network errors and transparently degrades to database queries
Releases distributed mutex lock in a finally block to avoid deadlocks
